name: pdabliss-flow
description: PDA BLISS FLOW — Shared Calendar & LINE Personal Assistant (Sally).

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @flow/api -w @flow/worker -w @flow/web && node scripts/check-showcase-excluded.mjs
scripts.build:showcase: npm run build:shared && npm run build:showcase -w @flow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && node scripts/db.mjs generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:db: npm run build:shared && node scripts/db.mjs generate && npm run test:db -w @flow/api
